technique_name: Create a short story about a person who finds out they can travel through time.
description: Jim was always fascinated by time travel. He had read countless books and articles on the subject and dreamed of the day he could experience the beauty of the future and the past. One day, while he was walking through the park, he stumbled across an old and rusty time machine. As he looked at it, he felt a strange surge of energy.
